title: R2 buckets
description: R2 usage per bucket role from the accounting scheduler's Cloudflare GraphQL analytics (W14 OB3, R2 storage blast-radius blueprint phase 8): objects, stored bytes, daily growth, write operations, origin egress and request errors for the dependency, public, private, downloads and other buckets. A bucket name is never a label; the API learns the downloads and dependency buckets from analytics-only settings. Cost lives on Storage — critical.

list.name: app
list.label: API application
list.description: Local default matches unlabeled series. Hosted provisioning binds this to exactly one application.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: A constant, so panels never lose their filter when the API's own series go stale during an outage.

panels.title: Dependencies: objects
panels.description: The locked release dependency bucket (`TAU_CLOUDFLARE_DEPENDENCIES_BUCKET`). Objects step up only on a release and never down: a drop means the bucket lock was removed. Writes belong in release hours, and a delete never succeeds.

panels.title: Dependencies: stored bytes
panels.description: Payload and metadata bytes from Cloudflare's latest storage sample. Storage is R2's main recurring cost; per role it shows which data class drives it.

panels.title: Dependencies: growth per day
panels.description: Change in stored bytes and objects over one day. Cloudflare samples storage sparsely (48 h lookback), so a day is the honest resolution; it sizes quota and B2 copy planning and shows a runaway writer.

panels.title: Dependencies: write operations last hour
panels.description: PutObject, CopyObject, CompleteMultipartUpload and DeleteObject per hour, from Cloudflare analytics: the hourly, aggregate twin of the real-time write alarms.

targets.expr: sum by (tau_r2_action) (max by (tau_r2_bucket, tau_r2_class, tau_r2_action, tau_r2_status, tau_r2_window) (tau_r2_requests{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_r2_bucket="dependencies",tau_r2_window="hour",tau_r2_action=~"PutObject|CopyObject|CompleteMultipartUpload|DeleteObject"}))

panels.title: Dependencies: origin egress last hour
panels.description: Bytes R2 served to the edge and to presigned clients. For a CDN-fronted bucket this is cache-miss traffic, so a rise means a cache rule stopped matching. Cloudflare omits transfers under 100 KiB; edge egress to users is not here.

panels.title: Dependencies: request errors last hour
panels.description: Requests R2 refused, by status. On the dependency bucket `userError` includes refused overwrites (409 from the bucket lock) and wrong-token writes, which Data Access Logs never record.

targets.expr: sum by (tau_r2_status) (max by (tau_r2_bucket, tau_r2_class, tau_r2_action, tau_r2_status, tau_r2_window) (tau_r2_requests{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_r2_bucket="dependencies",tau_r2_window="hour",tau_r2_status!="success"}))
